{{Quote|Two days ago the Imperials launched a multiple attack on targets in the Abrion and Dufilvian sectors. They severely damaged the military base at Ord Pardron and captured the Ukio system.|[[Talon Karrde]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Last Command" />}}
The '''Battle of Ord Pardron''' was a conflict between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|forces]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|military campaign]].<ref name="Last Command" />

The assault on the New Republic military base at Ord Pardron was used as a feint to draw New Republic forces away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], which Thrawn subsequently captured. The New Republic [[Ord Pardron sector defense outpost|outpost]] on the planet suffered severe damage during the assault.<ref name="Last Command" />
